milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to find/locate the cobblestone stairs structure at approximately (5, 1, 4) relative to spawn. The player must navigate to the east side and face the stairs. max_distance=6 prevents trivial completion from spawn (stairs are ~6 blocks away).

Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to find/locate the dark oak log structure at approximately (-6, 1, 4) relative to spawn. The player must navigate to the west side and face the logs. max_distance=6 ensures intentional navigation.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to find/locate the fire at (0, 0, -3) on netherrack within the lava gap, hidden behind a cobblestone wall at z=-1. max_distance=3 requires the player to physically navigate around the wall (to x<-1 or x>2) and move to z=-1 or beyond to be within range, preventing trivial satisfaction from spawn.
Uses inventory_has because mining a birch pressure plate drops the item into the player's inventory. The pressure plate is at (5, 4, 7) on the elevated platform accessed via the cobblestone stairs.

Uses inventory_has because mining a potted poppy drops a poppy and a flower pot into inventory. Checking for the poppy item confirms the block was successfully mined. Located at (4, 4, 7) on the elevated platform.

Uses inventory_has because charcoal (produced by smelting dark_oak_log in the furnace at (-5, 0, 5) with coal as fuel) ends up in the player's inventory. The player must mine a dark_oak_log block, place it in the furnace top slot with coal in the bottom slot, and wait for smelting.

Uses inventory_has because selling gray wool to the shepherd villager at (-2, 0, 10) yields an emerald (1:1 trade ratio, Count:1). The player mines gray wool blocks (at x=-4 to x=0, z=8) and trades with the villager. Having an emerald confirms a successful trade since no emeralds exist in the scene otherwise.

Uses position_inside_box because this is specifically a movement/traversal task — the player must build a bridge across the lava gap (z=-2 to z=-4, spanning x=-8 to x=8) and physically reach Zone B. Stone_bricks at gap edges (x=-10/-9 and x=9/10) prevent circumvention, so reaching Zone B requires actual bridging.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to find/locate the white stained glass windows on the front (south-facing) wall of the Zone B building at approximately (0, 2, -8). The player must be in Zone B (having bridged) and face the building front.
Uses inventory_has because mining a warped door drops the warped_door item into the player's inventory. The door is at (3, 1-2, -10) on the east wall of the Zone B building and can be broken by hand.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a gold block (9 gold ingots in a 3x3 grid on a crafting table) places the item in the player's inventory. The player retrieves 9 gold ingots from the chest at (0, 1, -11) and uses the crafting table at (1, 1, -10) inside the same Zone B building.

milestones.task: Hook a pig using fishing rod.
milestones.description: Uses inventory_has + position_inside_box because the player must obtain the fishing rod from the chest at (5, 1, -12) in the pig pen and be physically present in the pen area (x=4-8, z=-9 to z=-12) with the pigs. KNOWN LIMITATION: Available rule types cannot directly verify the hooking action occurred; this milestone verifies all achievable preconditions (rod in inventory, player positioned in the enclosed pen with NoAI pigs). The pen is only accessible after mining the warped door.
